notes.notes:

[h1]Bugs that didn't make it through summer[/h1]

-[b]The Width problem in case of multiple assaults is fixed[/b]
When a operation is started many times (when the opponent rolled you back for exemple), it was possible to pick each time a general assault and to increase the front width to ridiculous numbers.
That won't happen anymore.

-[b]Supply paths in the Stalingrad scenario[/b]
The supply path were not refreshing often enough and sometimes it was impossible to make staff turn-over or to equip units with tanks even if there was a clear path to the HQ.
This is fixed! Stalingrad awaits you!

-[b]Kharkov kessel in Summer 42[/b]
I reworked the Kharkov operation so when it becomes isolated, it clearly turn into an isolated pocket.
You won't have anymore that ridiculous soviet red arrows near Kharkov while you panzers are racing along the Don.

[h1]Rise of the White Sun is progressing well[/h1]

notes.title: Stalingrad has fallen! What's next?
notes.notes:
Hello,
I wanted to share with you  the content of the last update, a cool video and insights about what I am working on now.

[h2]That Game is devinitively too easy[/h2]
This youtuber stormed Stalingrad and secured a minor victory in his first game.
[previewyoutube=AQrxHu4aHS8;full][/previewyoutube]

I wanted to share this video because the youtuber uses some of the tricks that make a winning game in the Cauldrons of War serie.

[list]
[*]Focus! Don't let you being distracted by side objectives
[*]Split in defense! You will be able to hold the front while sending some of the troops elsewhere
[*]Move your units from one Army Group to another, to pack punch where it is more needed
[/list]

 [h2]What am I working on? And What are the projects for 2022?[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39863521/c18f8f7fae3ebf65a2ab3bd511bbc1e4e0c587ba.png[/img]

Play as every significant faction of 1920’s China : the Guomindang, the Chinese Communist Party, the Warlords and even the masters of the underworld - the Green Gang.

December 1926: as the victorious National Revolutionary Army units commanded by Bai Chongxi are approaching Shanghai, CCP and GMD agents are busy planning an uprising. Behind the scenes, high-ranking warlord officers are negotiating a comfortable future for themselves in exchange for betraying their masters while Jiang Jieshi is plotting with the Green Gang to get rid of his communist allies.

notes.title: CAULDRONS OF WAR STALINGRAD OFFICIAL RELEASE
notes.notes:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1497230?utm_source=SteamNews][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39863521/b22fa4ec60639eae4d6ac658eae9d40c7753b07d.png[/img][/url]

It have been a long road, but it is now the time to release this game officially.

What will you find in Cauldrons of War Stalingrad?

From Crimea to Stalingrad and the Caucasus oil fields, you will lead the Axis or the Soviet forces in the bitter fightings of the eastern Front in 1942.

Cauldrons of War - Stalingrad is an immersive 'command at the highest level'  wargame with tough decisions to make.
Its clean mechanics and low complexity allows the game to focus on what is really important : strategical decisions.
There is no micromanagement here, but more depth than you imagine.

[h2]Play the main operations in 1942 on the eastern Front :[/h2] 
As the German, will you grasp the Baku oilfields ? As the Soviet, will you trap a whole German army near Stalingrad ?

[h2]Play fast and often [/h2]: you don't need a 100+ hours investment in a monster game. Some scenarios can be played in 1 or 2 hour. But don't worry, the game contains several scenarios and is challenging enough to keep you entertained for a long time.

[h2]Play against the AI or against your friends[/h2] : with a hot seat mode and a Play By Email Mode 

Cauldrons of War - Stalingrad is the second opus of the "Cauldrons series".
If ever you have played Cauldrons of War - Barbarsossa, you won't be disoriented, but you will notice some improvements here and there.

I am sure you will particulary enjoy the Stalingrad City scenario.
Unlike the other scenarios at Army group level, you will command here companies in the hell of Stalingrad.

==> [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1497230?utm_source=SteamNews]Get Yours![/url]

Have fun!

Maestro Cinetik

PS: 
[u]What is next?[/u]

Players are still making interesting feedbacks and proposals, so even if I declared the game finished, you can expect some nice patch from time to time.

I have tons of materials about the battle for the city of Stalingrad. In fact, far too much material to be put in that game. It is reasonible to expect in the futur some pure urban battle spin-off with the whole battle for the city at company scale (That will requier a whole year of development at first guessing)

notes.title: Stalingrad at last!
notes.notes:
[b]Stalingrad, September 14th[/b]

The Germans made a final push against a battered 62nd Army and the Volga is only some hundred of meters away.
Could the soviets resist just one more day until the 13th Guards Division could cross the Volga?
The seasoned veterans of the 71th german Infantry division are confident: the end of the campaign is at hand...


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39863521/b22fa4ec60639eae4d6ac658eae9d40c7753b07d.png[/img]

[h2]The Stalingrad Scenario enters its BETA stage.[/h2]

It describes the fightings for the center of Stalingrad from September 14th to September 25th.

The Cauldrons of War system have been totally reworked to offer you a deep dive into the hell of Stalingrad.

What changes compared to your regular Cauldrons of War scenarios?

-The scale is the company, not the Army
-1 Turn is one day or 1 night
-You fight for blocks of buildings, not for operations

[h3]And yes, you can already play it![/h3]

[b]==> type "C" + "S" while on the main menu to unlock the scenario.[/b]*

For the moment, some options are desactivated, like the save system, the hot seat, the PBEM and the soviet side. 
But you can enjoy a full solo experience as the German.

Have fun!

Maestro Cinetik

notes.title: The HQ Management patch
notes.notes:
[h2]You can now transfer ressources between your Army groups or Fronts.[/h2]

This may not succeed however :

Generals were constantly asking for reinforcements and those had to be taken from other Army groups whose general would fight not to let their assets go...

You can now too play this petty games.
Click on your Fronts or Army Groups : you will see a new HQ icon along your armies. This icon gives you access to new actions :
- Ask for more trucks
- Ask for more reserves
- Ask for more aircrafts

If playing as the Axis, you ma be offered the possibility to activate Army Group Crimea if it isn't active.

This new transfer feature has been playested in the previous days and seems to work fine. I hope you will enjoy it.

[h2]Other minor features[/h2]

-Turkey can now directly besiege Batumi
-Giant Pockets have been added to the western part of the Caucasus
-A new Axis event  have been added in the case the Army Group Center destroys all the soviets units in Rhzev or Orel.
(Some of these features have been added since a week or two , but they are now well tested and debugged, so they make it to the "official patch")

[h2]Become a bug buster[/h2]

In the menu, I've added a "bug report" button : this feature will greatly facilitate my bug hunt.

Here is a list of some of the recently killed bugs:

-Some Buggy operations have been fixed : Narva, Kharkov, The Caucasus Giant Pockets
-You now really score points as the Soviet for taking Kharkov
-If you send aircrafts to "briefly" help Model, you won't lose them next turn.
-You no longer spend 2 Command points to fight partisans in cleaning operations.

Many other minor bugs have fallen, but I just keep track of the "Star Bugs".


[h2]The Stalingrad City Scenario[/h2]

Still in progress... 
I am testing a lot of ideas... and discard a lot of them.
But I am starting to get satisfied.

Have fun!

Maestro Cinetik

notes.title: Quality of Life Patch
notes.notes:
Here are 2 features you were waiting for :

[h2]Display units on the map[/h2]

German symbols for Armies, Corps and Divisions will now be displayed on map if you choose so (use for that the new button on the bottom left of the screen).
A glance at the map is now enough to evaluate the balance of power.

[h2]The minimap on the operation screen[/h2]

You can now replace the illustration by a minimap when you are on the operation screen.
Even better : hovering actions that send units to other operations will display that minimap and center it on the concerned operation : isn't that great?
You won't have anymore to switch between screens to figure out where you should send your armies.

[h2]And what about the new map I promised?[/h2]

It is still a work in progress, BUT :
[b]try that cheat code "C"+"S"[/b] when you are on the map screen.
That will change the current map for the futur map.
(Borders are pre war, some cites are not well positionned etc..., but at least you will have the same feeling that the futur map will ptovide)

Once that map will be out, I will certainly suppress all other maps.


[h2]And what about the Stalingrad Scenario?[/h2]

The game system does not suits well to urban fightings at company level...
So that scenario will be a whole different game in the game.
I would say that I've done 20% of the work.

2 game systems in the same game may not be a good designer's practice, but I just don't care ^^
(I hope you won't mind neither)

Have fun!

Maestro Cinetik

notes.title: Cauldrons of War Stalingrad - some new features, some bugs erradicated
notes.notes:
Hello gamers!

[h2]New content[/h2]

[u][b]New action tooltip[/b][/u]
You have been asking for a long time for a better "tooltip" feature.
You can now display tooltips when hovering actions. The delay before displaying the information may be too long, but I though that a too short delay would be annoying : tell me what do you think.

[u][b]A new map button to display supply capabilities[/b][/u]
The map may be overcrowded with all those informations, so I guess you will only use it from time to time.
If you press that button you will display local and HQ's rail points, and the number of HQ's trucks left.
If an operation is a remote battlefield or an isolated operation you will also know it at quick glance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39863521/ae6d2d11c6808d3ee98f612840cede286187c281.png[/img]

[h2]Bugs killed[/h2]

Among the many bugs that annoyed you, I am pleased to announce that the bug who left operations with zero command points is now in the bug's hell in good company.
(That bug infested  frequently Army groups B, Don, Crimea and South West Front)

Is that damn "southern approach to Stalingrad" bug really dead? Or will he rise again? : After intensive testing I couldn't trigger it... So I guess it is fixed now. (I knew that calling an exorcist was the right solution in this case).

[h2]Game Balance[/h2]

As the german you need to destroy less soviet armies in Fall Blau to earn victory points.


------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h1]Features and contents to come[/h1]

[h2]The Stalingrad City scenario[/h2]

The work is still in progress.
The first scenario will be about the fightings in Stalingrad Center from September 14th to September 28th (final dates may vary slightly). 
Weary but confident germans will start the scenario by pushing towards the Volga, only slowed by remnents of broken soviet units. 
Only to be pushed back by the powerful 13th guard division that just arrived.
As the scenario progresses, new urban fighting tactics are experimented and the battlefield gets more and more destroyed.
At scenario end, taking a single block of buildings will only be possible trough carefull assault planification.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39863521/4750239156b0a65690a4502f259a41c2f947958c.png[/img]

[h2]A new map, more "General staff" style[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39863521/35095d7dbdcbb64a82d4315dbcaf82c7005667ae.png[/img]

[h2]On the to do list for who know when[/h2]

-Some more operations for the Turkish Army (towards Tbilissi and Batumi)
-Some rework of western Caucasus operations with the possibility to create german pockets there
-A Stalingrad city scenario about the fightings in the Factory sector (if ever you liked the central Stalingrad scenario)


Have Fun!

Maestro Cinetik

notes.title: First patches, game tips and what's next insights
notes.notes:
[h1]First patch content][/h1]

[h3]Bug fixing[/h3]

I was suprised by how few bugs you've reported. That "pre release" polishing week was finally worth it.
Among the fixed bugs here are the nastiest I have erradicated :

-"The leningrad saved game vanishing" bug : RIP little angel gone too soon
-"The Long Campaign lasting just a few turns" bug: You won't miss us naughty boy
-"The never ending Uranus campaign (german side)" bug: Farewell and never come back!

I have also made some Cheat code tinkering.
-Cheat codes now triggers a nice "powerup arcade game sound" (this is all that you deserve you shameless cheaters)
-The Aircraft cheat code was bugged for the german side : this is fixed now
-I have added one more cheat code, but it is so powefull that I hesitate to talk about it for the moment...

[h3]A community internationalization modding tool[/h3]

Some of you asked me where to find the language files to translate them. I facilitated the process. You can now generate a single file in a simple format (not even one of those XML or CSV things) : just text you can modify using your notepad.
For those using different fonts, I've made a test for chinese fonts : this shall work well.


[h1]How to play and how to win?][/h1]

I know that many of you are struggling to unlock that long campaign.

Here are a few tips and a strategy that should help you getting those 8 points.
This is not the 11-20pts strategy, just the 7-8 points prudent strategy.

First, let's pick some limited objectives.
I propose Stalingrad, Leningrad and Maikop

[h2]The Drive towards Stalingrad [/h2]

[b]Pro tip 1 [/b]: Do not try to take Voronezh, or you will just end being bogged down just enough turns to arrive too late at Stalingrad.
[b]Pro tip 2 [/b]: Don't lose command points by shelling : just attack and progress
[b]Pro tip 3[/b] : those romanian cavalry units are very useful to progress in an empty steppe
[b]Pro tip 4[/b] : You don't need to spend all your Command points for Stalingrad, you need also to progress fast towards Rostov. If you are not disciplined enough to do that, I suggest you split your Army group South 
[b]Pro tip 5[/b] :Don't spend to many points to protect your flanks too early. 
[b]Pro tip 6[/b] :When asked if you want Stalingrad as a 3pts Objective : say yes.

[h2]Taking Maïkop [/h2]

[b]Pro tip 1 [/b]: You will need a Panzer Army there. You may pick the Millerovo choice or send one Panzer Army using your command points. Do what you want, but the 17th Army alone will be too slow to trap the ennemy and get to Rostov in time.

[b]Pro tip 2 [/b]: Rush Maïkop and take it fast, or the soviet will bring there too many reinforcements. Once Maïkop is taken you will be proposed by event to bomb the Grozny and Baku oilfields : accept it!

[h2]Taking Leningrad [/h2]

[b]Pro tip 1 [/b]: Leningrad only counts in Victory conditions if you choose so by sending the 11th Army north after the fall of Sevastopol

[b]Pro tip 2 [/b]: Just shell Leningrad with your Siege Giant Guns during 3-4 weeks, then assault.

You should have at the time :
1 Victory point for controlling the Don-Volga isthmus.
3 Victory points for Stalingrad (if you followed the above tips, you should have get to the city in time and have taken it before the soviet brings in too many reinforcements)
2 points for the bombing of Caucasus oil fields
2 points for Leningrad (or may be 3 I forgot)
==> 8 points
If you don't lose ground, that will be enough 

The Historical Gamer made some great videos recently : you can certainly learn from his successes and his mistakes.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0xOz-M9iz1w&t=7

[h1]What's next][/h1]

not necessarily in that order :

-Some more operations for Turkey (Towards Batumi and Tbilissi)
-Some more display buttons for the map (you may want to see the strengh ratios for each operations)
-The Urban Stalingrad Scenarios
-A rework of the map (Again!)


Have fun!


Maestro Cinetik

notes.title: A few more days to wait
notes.notes:
Dear Cauldrons of War fans,

Sorry about the delay. 
I've changed the release date (slightly).


The reason for it is terrible yet simple: 
when I was getting ready to push that one launch button, I came to the realization that a certain number of influencers we had historical links with didn't have the opportunity yet to showcase the game, as a lot of them were not as aware as you are all, dear fans, of the existence of this game or its imminent release. 

As an Early Access release is still a release, and treated as such by the Steam algorithm, keeping our original schedule without much further ado would definitely jeopardize the short term discoverability of the game, and impact negatively our reach. 

Knowing that, I took the frustrating decision to push a bit further the date in order to give us the best chances.

As you know, Cauldrons of War : Stalingrad is a game developed by one single person (myself) and I have responsibilities towards my fans, but also towards my family, who has been supporting me from the very beginning in this peculiar yet exciting endeavor. I owe it to them to make sure that Cauldrons fares as well as possible in order to make their daily sacrifices worth it. 
And if it means adding another small week to the release date of the game in order to focus on marketing, so be it - hope it is fine with you all dear friends. 

Apologies again for the lack of feedback in regard of a decision I only reached yesterday evening, in the face of the newer data and trends available to me.

Bear with us a few more days, and I will make sure to make this wait worth your while!

Maestro Cinetik

notes.title: Youtube preview
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=CL1nLeGcM7Q;full][/previewyoutube]

As the early access release approaches I can tell you what there's in and what is new in CoW Stalingrad

[h2]List of Scenarios you will have at Early access release time[/h2]

[list]
[*][u]Fall Blau[/u]
[*][u]Edelweiss[/u]
[*][u]Kharkov & Crimea in May-June 42[/u]
[*][u]Wintergewitter (Winter Storm)[/u]
[*][u]Uranus [/u]
[*][u]The Grand Campaign [/u]
[/list]

[h3]Fall Blau[/h3]
From June to December 1942, try to conquer insanly vast territory, from Vornonezh to Stalingrad and Baku.
All fronts are featured in this Scenario, so you will even have a chance to take Leningrad.
The soviet will have his own massive offensives against german forces in the North and the Center while conducing defensive battles in the South and the Caucasus. The scenario covers the november and december months so heavy soviet-counter offensives may occur : will the german player be able to reinforce his defences on time?

[h3]Edelweiss[/h3]
This scenario is shorter and features only the fightings in the Caucasus, from the taking of Rostov to the stalemate in November. No Blitzkrieg here for the german, but bitter fightings in remote battlefields nearly impossible to supply in a mountainous region. Will the german be able to secure the rich caucasian oil fields? The outcome of the war depends on it!

[h3]Kharkov & Crimea in May-June 42[/h3]
A quick to play scenario set in the South area. While both the Soviets and the Wehrmacht are preparing for the summer offensive, smaller but important operations are taking place in Crimea and around Kharkov. The result have been two important german victories, but the heavily fortified and defended city of Sevastopol may well resist until the end.

[h3]Wintergewitter (Winter Storm)[/h3]

Another super short scenario, centered on the Don's bend.
Can von Manstein save the 6th Army trapepd in Stalingrad while the soviets are on the verge of launching a massive offensive (Jupiter)?
This scenario is ideal to experiment the soviet's might in the end of 1942.

[h3]Uranus[/h3]

This scenario runs from November 42 to March 43. You play only the southern fronts. Here the soviet is on the offensive and the german is exhausted. Can the soviet player reach Rostov to cut the entire Army Group A from its supply lines? And then, can he reach the Dniepr and cross it? That would shorten the war by 1 or 2 years!


[h3]The Grand campaign[/h3]

Play the whole fronts from May 42 to March 43. I know players like that kind of super big scenarios.
Games will certainly be very different from history with such a timespan. Any side will have the time to crush the oppenent beyond any historical outcome. I believe this one will be perfect to play against a human opponent.

notes.title: Wintergewitter scenario Analysis
notes.notes:
I will post here regularly previews and content analysis.

Here is one about operation Wintergewitter (with even a playthrough video if you scroll to the bottom)

Wintergewitter is the shortest scenario of CoW-Stalingrad : only 2 Army Groups, and 4 operations to manage. Its duration is 4 turns and it can be played in 20-30 minutes.

I hesitated before including such a small scenario, but the situation was too interesting not to do so. Also, that scale is perfect for playing during any boring remote video-meeting (just turn off the sound)

[h2]The situation at start[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39863521/1414e56cb745f44bbc63933687d3918b6216ad0a.png[/img]

The 6th Army is trapped in the Stalingrad pocket, and is supplied by air. The soviet forces tried to reduce the pocket but the entrapped german forces were too strong. The 6th army is now too low on ammunition to try to escape the pocket by its own means. Also, Hitler ordred that Stalingrad was not abandonned.

General von Manstein gathered some troops to rescue the 6th Army but the forces at hand are far from sufficient. The Soviets are pilling up new units in the Italian held sector of the Don River, and the 5th soviet Tank Army is attackind hard across the Chir River.

Can you deliver the 6th Army before the total collapse of your defensive lines ?

[h2]In the pocket[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39863521/28b07c6ee372432f2ec32704d27c0a02e459f3e4.png[/img]

There is not much you can do here. I suggest you spend none of your precious command points here. The soviet forces have to refit after their last assault, so you can expect one or two quite weeks here.

[h2]The Wintergewitter operation[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39863521/0946b1249447c8ac02eaa8eceb057f4b4405843a.png[/img]

The soviets have here only a depleted army : you can certainly crush it with ease, but can you pierce to the pocket before the soviet sends in reinforcements ? Probably not… The romanian forces here are not totally useless : they can progress, scout and even finish a disorganized soviet army. What you are lacking here is a good infantry army to make the initial attack.

[h2]The Chir river[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39863521/817b84bbd8e7d9ba0dafa34f697343dc6053b463.png[/img]

Your panzers did a great job to slow the soviets in the Chir area. But your forces are now tired and depleted. The ennemy will probably try again to pierce your defences here. This operation is also the link between the Wintergewitter operation and the Italian sector : from here you can send reinforcement to either one of this two other operations.

[h2]The Italians[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39863521/0946b1249447c8ac02eaa8eceb057f4b4405843a.png[/img]

Well… The soviet is preparing something here… The Italian army is strong enough to offer some resistance, but its weaponry is obsolete. With one command point here, the Italians won’t be able to resist a massive soviet offensive. It seems we are on the eve of such an offensive.


[h2]The Victory conditions[/h2]

You Win points if you hold the Chir River (3), if You hold the Donetz river (2) and if you rescue the Stalingrad pocket (5). You also earn points if your your losses are low and if the Axis alliance score stays above 25.

[h2]The losses and Axis cohesion score victory conditions[/h2]

You have a real problem here : your Romanian and Italian units are fragile : every time one of this units is destroyed, your losses raise and your Axis cohesion score drops. If you are not able to preserve these units, you may lose some easy to earn victory points…

[h2]The easy victory : containing the soviet on the Chir and the Don[/h2]

If you hold the Chir and the Donetz, you earn 5 points : You will only miss 1 point to score a victory. To be sure to get that result, you will need to choose to support Army Group B when Saturn is launched (This is done by an event choice). The Italians correctly supported will be able to slow the soviets (at least during this scenario). If things are getting bad, you can send them the panzer unit fighting on the Chir river, call off Wintergewitter and use the rescuing units to stop the soviets.

This strategy should bring you either a draw or a minor victory

[h2]The major victory : rescuing the pocket[/h2]

This can be done, but you will need luck and soviet mistakes. They are two ways to reach the pocket : from the Aksay (Wintergewitter operation) and from the Chir. You may try to alternate those two approaches to lure the Artificial Intelligence about your main axis of progression.

Any delay or bad timing and the soviets will stop you cold with reinforcements. Your chance is that if you are playing versus the AI, your opponent will play like if the scenario is longer : it sometimes may ignore (even if rarely ) your attempt to get to Stalingrad from the Aksay to concentrate its attention on the Chir River and the Saturn operations.

This is because in case of success, the soviet would be in position to cut the entire Army group A from its supply bases : the relief of the Soviet pocket would become meaningless in that case.

Whatever the strategy you will choose, you will have to adapt during play to the soviet actions because in this scenario, you clearly have lost the initiative.
